law: These bulk exports are appropriate for offline use cases, complementing Apple Music API, which is best for online use.
With access to the raw data and the information in this documentation, you can use Apple Music Feed in many ways.
Many large-scale data-processing frameworks, like Hadoop and Spark, use this format.
Use the token to request metadata for the latest feed export for a specific data set.
Use the token to request links to parts of the data for a feed export.
